evidence_candidates.excerpt: The ETP4HPC SRA6 hardware white paper describes HBM as performant but costly, package-fixed in capacity, and power intensive; it also calls for coherent memory and efficient data movement across processors and accelerators, with CXL as one relevant interconnect.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: ETP4HPC's 2025 hardware roadmap frames future HPC memory as a multi-objective choice among HBM performance, capacity, cost, power, coherence, and data movement rather than a bandwidth-only choice.
